items.title: International Ice Hockey Federation bars Russia's U20 team from World Junior Championship in Canada
items.teaser: Following CAS rulings and international sponsor pushback, the IIHF has announced that Canada will remain the host for the 2027 World Juniors from 26 December to 5 January and Russia will not take part.

items.title: Ukraine war latest: Russia launches mass attack on Odesa Oblast as Ukraine strikes airfield, drone launch site in Russia
items.teaser: Key developments on Nov. 14-15 Ukraine strikes Russian military airfield in Astrakhan Oblast, drone launch site in Oryol Oblast, General Staff says Russia launches 'mass attack' on Odesa Oblast as strikes kill 4, injure 69 across Ukraine over past day US floats NATO membership for Ukraine in exchange

items.title: EU, Ukraine have roadmap to meet interim rule-of-law benchmarks – Kos
items.teaser: The European Commission and the Ukrainian government have stepped up efforts to meet interim benchmarks in the areas of democracy and the rule of law, aiming to achieve this goal in the first half of 2027.

items.title: Drei Verletzte nach Drohnenangriffe in Charkiw
items.teaser: Zwei Männer und eine Frau wurden in Charkiw durch feindliche Drohnenangriffe verletzt, teilte die Staatsanwaltschaft der Region Charkiw via Telegram mit.

items.title: EU ambassador tells Guardian about delegation's work in Kyiv as Russian attacks intensify
items.teaser: EU Ambassador to Ukraine Katarína Mathernová has highlighted the harsh reality of operating in Kyiv as relentless Russian attacks disrupt water and sewage systems and target foreign diplomatic missions.

items.title: Nach Sabotageangriff: Estland schließt Grenze zu Russland
Russian drone hits apartment building in Kharkiv
items.teaser: An enemy drone struck a high-rise residential building in Kharkiv.

items.title: European commissioner and Ukrainian government discuss reforms required to meet EU benchmarks in first half of 2027
items.teaser: Marta Kos says the EU and Ukraine have made progress on reforms aimed at meeting interim democracy and rule-of-law benchmarks in the first half of 2027.

items.title: Prince Harry visits Lviv to support Ukrainian veterans at Invictus Games
items.teaser: During his visit, Prince Harry attended wheelchair rugby competitions and met with Ukrainian participants, many of whom use adaptive sports as part of their recovery from war-related injuries.

items.title: 8 Personen in Estland wegen versuchten Brandanschlags auf Rüstungswerk im Auftrag Russlands festgenommen
items.teaser: Die estnische Staatsanwaltschaft gab bekannt, dass in der Nacht zum Samstag, dem 14. November, ein Brandanschlag auf das Gebäude des Rüstungsunternehmens Threod in Viimsi verübt wurde.

items.title: Auto dealership damaged in Russian attack in Kyiv region
items.teaser: The Porsche Zahid dealership in Kyiv region was damaged in a Russian attack and has temporarily suspended operations.

items.title: Fuel storage tanks burned out in Russian port of Ust-Luga following attack – video
items.teaser: New satellite imagery reveals extensive fire damage and firefighting foam remnants at Ust-Luga's oil terminal after Ukrainian drones struck the strategic Leningrad Oblast export hub on 11 November.

items.title: Estland schließt ab Dezember Grenzübergänge nach Russland
items.teaser: Estland unterstützt die Ukraine im Kampf gegen Russland - unter anderem mit Drohnen. Eine Drohnenfabrik wurde am Wochenende angegriffen, laut Estland von russischen Agenten. Nun schließt Estland seine drei Grenzübergänge zum Nachbarland.

items.title: 'Fantastic female warrior' – Drone operator Rayana killed fighting Russian forces
items.teaser: Rayana joined the army voluntarily in 2024, becoming the first woman in the Chechen Sheikh Mansur Volunteer Battalion.

items.title: FPV drone strikes in Kharkiv leave three injured
items.teaser: Two men and a woman were injured in enemy FPV drone strikes in Kharkiv.

items.title: Russian army carries out six attacks violating Geneva Convention provisions in nine days – Ministry of Defense
items.teaser: Between November 2 and 10, the Russian army carried out six attacks across Ukraine, each of which violated several provisions of international humanitarian law.

items.title: Tallinn beschuldigt GRU: Estland schließt nach Brandanschlag seine Grenze zu Russland
items.teaser: Ein mutmaßlicher Sabotageakt gegen eine Rüstungsfirma erschüttert Russlands kleinen Nachbarn Estland. Der Verdacht fällt auf den russischen Militärgeheimdienst. Acht Tatverdächtige werden festgenommen - die Regierung zieht weitere Konsequenzen.

items.title: In Kramatorsk griffen russische Drohnen zweimal Feuerwehr an
items.teaser: In der Stadt Kramatorsk, Region Donezk, attackierten russische Drohnen zweimal eine Feuerwehrwache. Ein Einsatzfahrzeug geriet in Brand.

items.title: Estonia to close all border crossings with Russia after attempted sabotage against defence company
items.teaser: Estonia will close its border crossing points with Russia to curb hostile activities and sanctions evasion after detaining suspects in an attempted arson attack on drone manufacturer Threod Systems.

items.title: Innensenatorin: Bremen beendet Kampagne gegen Islamismus vorzeitig
items.teaser: Mit Bildern von einem Wolf im Schafspelz hatte der Verfassungsschutz vor Islamisten gewarnt. Bremens Innensenatorin sagt nun: Das Ziel der Kampagne war richtig, die Umsetzung aber nicht.

items.title: Ukraine's embassy blames Russia for Warsaw monument graffiti, calls it bid to ‘sow hostility’ between Ukrainians, Poles
items.teaser: Inscriptions reading "Slava UPA" ("Glory to the Ukrainian Insurgent Army"), painted in red, appeared on two monuments in Warsaw, Polish broadcaster TVN24 reported on Nov. 14.

items.title: Moldova rejects federalization scenario: 'Russia dusted it off'
items.teaser: Moldovan Parliament Speaker Igor Grosu has rejected the idea of federalizing the country, saying that Russia has "dusted it off."

items.title: At least 30 explosions reported at Russian airbase and weapons-testing site 650 km from front line after Ukrainian strike
items.teaser: Ukraine's General Staff confirmed strikes on Akhtubinsk airfield in Astrakhan Oblast and a drone port in Oryol Oblast. The two facilities support Russian military aviation and drone attacks on Ukraine.

items.title: Estonia accuses Russia of attempted sabotage at defence company
items.teaser: Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna has said Moscow is increasingly turning to hybrid sabotage to divert European support from Ukraine after authorities foiled a 14 November arson attack on Threod Systems.

items.title: Ukrainische Verteidigungskräfte greifen Flugplatz „Achtubinsk“ und Drohnenstützpunkt in Region Orjol an
items.teaser: In der Nacht zum 15. November griffen die ukrainischen Verteidigungskräfte den Militärflugplatz „Achtubinsk“ in der Region Astrachan, Russland, sowie einen Drohnenstützpunkt nahe der Siedlung Zimbulowa in der Region Orjol an.

items.title: Estland schließt nach Anschlagsversuch Grenzen zu Russland
items.teaser: Der russische Militärgeheimdienst GRU soll einen Anschlag auf eine Drohnenfabrik in Estland versucht haben. Es wäre nicht das erste Mal in jüngster Zeit.

items.title: Estland schließt nach Sabotageakt die Grenze zu Russland
items.teaser: Die USA haben nach den Worten des ukrainischen Präsidenten Wolodymyr Selenskyj der Ukraine die Nato-Mitgliedschaft im Gegenzug für einen Gebietsverzicht in Aussicht gestellt.

items.title: Russians strike warehouses in Vyshhorod district, leaving one injured
items.teaser: A man was injured in a Russian attack on warehouse facilities in the Vyshhorod district of Kyiv region.

items.title: Prince Harry arrives in Lviv for Invictus Games – photos
items.teaser: Invictus Games founder Prince Harry has visited Lviv to cheer on wounded Ukrainian service members in wheelchair rugby as 500 participants compete to represent Ukraine in Birmingham in 2027.

items.title: Nach Geheimdienstwarnungen - Mehrere US‑Minister in Sicherheit gebracht
items.teaser: Konkrete Anschlagsdrohungen führen zu besonderem Schutz für US-Regierungsvertreter.

items.title: Jordanien - Drei Männer für Anschlag auf Kirche zum Tode verurteilt
items.teaser: In Jordanien sind drei Männer wegen des Anschlags auf eine Kirche zum Tode verurteilt worden.

items.title: Russians attack Odesa, damaging infrastructure
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked Odesa, damaging infrastructure and setting several cars on fire.

items.title: Romanian PM condemns Russian attack on three commercial vessels in Black Sea
items.teaser: Romanian PM Luca Niculescu has warned of worsening Black Sea security caused by Russia's war against Ukraine following drone strikes on vessels, including the Greek-flagged tanker Evia Petrol V near the Danube Delta.

items.title: Russians strike Odesa, damaging civilian infrastructure
items.teaser: Odesa authorities have confirmed that civilian infrastructure across the region – including grain warehouses and a car dealership in Odesa – was destroyed in fires caused by a Russian attack on 15 November.

items.title: Russian forces attack car with drone in Kharkiv, injuring three people
items.teaser: Russian forces struck a civilian car with a drone in the Shevchenkivskyi district of Kharkiv.

items.title: Viele Treffer der Shahed-Drohnen auf Umspannwerke passieren wegen Geschwindigkeitsbegrenzungen des Starshield-Systems – Selenskyj
items.teaser: Viele russische Treffer mit Shahed-Drohnen auf ukrainische Umspannwerke erfolgen durch die weiterhin bestehende Begrenzung der Geschwindigkeit der Starshield-Terminals entlang der Frontlinie und in den vorübergehend besetzten Gebieten.

items.title: EU forces boarded suspected Russian shadow fleet tanker, says chief diplomat – photos
items.teaser: EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas said Operation Irini personnel boarded the MV Midag on 13 November under UN maritime law and confirmed it was sailing under a false flag. The boarding comes ahead of new EU sanctions.

items.title: Russian forces attack infrastructure facility in Zaporizhzhia, injuring one person
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked an infrastructure facility in the Khortytskyi district of Zaporizhzhia, injuring one person.

items.title: Defense Forces strike Akhtubinsk airfield. drone launch site in Russia's Oryol region overnight
items.teaser: Ukraine's Defense Forces struck the Akhtubinsk military airfield in Russia's Astrakhan region and a drone launch site near the settlement of Tsymbulova in the Oryol region during the night of November 15.

items.title: Part of Dnipro and Kamianske without power due to repeat Russian strike on energy facility
items.teaser: Russian attacks damaged grid equipment, cutting power to parts of Dnipro and Kamianske. Crews have begun emergency repairs.

items.title: Three injured in Russian drone attack on car in Kharkiv
items.teaser: Kharkiv mayor has reported that a Russian combat drone struck a civilian car on the afternoon of 15 November, igniting a fire and injuring three people, including passers-by.

items.title: Enemy strikes energy facility, triggering emergency power outages in Zaporizhzhia and Dnipropetrovsk regions
items.teaser: Russian forces struck an energy facility, resulting in emergency power outages in the Zaporizhzhia and Dnipropetrovsk regions.

items.title: EU naval forces board Russian shadow fleet tanker sailing under false flag in Mediterranean as new sanctions loom
items.teaser: The inspection of the MV MIDAG marks another step in the EU's efforts to disrupt Russia's oil exports through its shadow fleet.

items.title: Emergency power outages in two Ukrainian oblasts due to Russian attack
items.teaser: Ukraine’s electricity operator Ukrenergo has confirmed forced emergency outages in Zaporizhzhia and Dnipropetrovsk oblasts, noting that repair teams will restore power once security conditions permit.

items.title: How surgeon Yurii Lazarenko is saving Ukrainian soldiers' arms with titanium implants
Zwei Fabriken in Tatarstan und Hubschrauberwerk in Region Brjansk von ukrainischen Verteidigungskräften attackiert
items.teaser: In der Nacht zum 15. November griffen die ukrainischen Verteidigungskräfte den petrochemischen Komplex „Nischnekamskneftechim“ in Tatarstan und das Werk des Militärindustriekomplexes „Monolit“ in der russischen Region Brjansk an.

items.title: Russian drones attack fire station twice in Kramatorsk
items.teaser: Russian drones attacked a fire and rescue station twice in Kramatorsk, Donetsk region, setting a service vehicle on fire.

items.title: Angriffe auf beiden Seiten: Ukraine und Russland melden Tote und Verletzte
items.teaser: Erneut hat Russland mehrere Ziele in der Ukraine angegriffen. Dabei wurden am Abend drei Menschen getötet, allein aus Saporischschja wurden zuvor 22 Verletzte gemeldet, darunter Kinder. Russland meldete einen Toten durch ukrainische Angriffe.

items.title: Starshield restrictions hamper Ukraine's ability to defend energy infrastructure from Russian drones, Zelensky says
items.teaser: "Russian forces are targeting substations with Shahed drones. And many of these strikes get through precisely because speed restrictions remain in place for Starshield terminals along the front line and in temporarily occupied territories," Zelensky said

items.title: Ukrainian forces strike two plants in Tatarstan, helicopter manufacturer in Bryansk region
items.teaser: Ukraine's Defense Forces struck the Nizhnekamskneftekhim petrochemical complex in Tatarstan overnight on November 15, as well as the Monolit military-industrial complex plant in Russia's Bryansk region.

items.title: Battle of the Sections: 307 vs. 337 (and a Little 301 Too) on Forced Labor Issues
items.teaser: Section 337 is typically used to address infringements of intellectual property rights, but the language in the statute is fairly broad, and someone decided that it was worth trying to apply it to imports made with forced labor, bringing a case to the U.S. International Trade Commission (ITC).
items.source: Int. Economic Law and Policy Blog

items.title: Angriff auf Tschornomorsk: Sechs Verletzte, DTEK-Anlage beschädigt
items.teaser: Die Russen haben Tschornomorsk in der Region Odessa angegriffen.

items.title: Pentagon stalls Ukraine’s license to produce Patriot air defense missiles, undermining efforts to protect cities from Russian missile strikes
items.teaser: A licensing delay is holding back Ukraine's plans to produce its own Patriot interceptors, even as US deliveries remain slow and Russian ballistic missiles continue to threaten Ukrainian cities and critical infrastructure.

items.title: Dutch defense company opens office in Ukraine, plans joint production
items.teaser: Dutch defense company Artillerie Inrichtingen Armaments (AIA) has opened an office in Ukraine and plans to launch engineering operations, with a view to establishing a production facility in the western part of the country in the future.

items.title: More Submissions to the ITC on the Meaning of Discrimination in Section 338
items.teaser: In my post on comments I submitted to the ITC on the term "discriminatory" in Section 338, my main point was that discrimination can't be based solely on the effect of the measure, because that will intrude too far into policy space. Some version of intent has to be considered as well.
items.source: Int. Economic Law and Policy Blog

items.title: Ukraine's General Staff also reports strike on Akhtubinsk airfield in Russia and drone launch site
items.teaser: Ukraine's General Staff says a strike on Russia's Akhtubinsk airfield caused a secondary detonation at a missile kit depot, and a drone launch site in Oryol Oblast was hit.

items.title: Two Weeks in Review: 2—13 November 2026
items.teaser: Over the last two weeks, it is chiefly the institutions of international law that have been in focus. There have been a number of responses to the judicial elections at the International Court of Justice, from congratulations to the incoming benchers, to consternation at the growing disparity in global representation,

items.title: Many drone strikes on substations get through due to Starshield speed restrictions – Zelensky
items.teaser: Many Russian Shahed-type drone strikes on Ukrainian substations get through because speed restrictions remain in place for Starshield terminals along the frontline and in temporarily occupied territories.

items.title: EU forces board suspected Russian shadow fleet tanker in Mediterranean, Kallas says
items.teaser: "The EU will keep disrupting Russia's shadow fleet at sea and through diplomatic means," Kaja Kallas said.

items.title: Married couple who went a year without bread in Oleshky embrace two-year-old grandson after rescue
items.teaser: Nina and Anatolii escaped occupied Kherson Oblast and held their grandson for the first time. They had survived on goosefoot pancakes and rationed vegetables amid exorbitant food prices.

items.title: Zelenskyy: Starshield restrictions prevent Ukrainian drones from catching up with jet-powered Shaheds
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has said Starshield terminals cut off interceptor drones at 161 km/h, so many Russian jet-powered Shaheds hit substations.

items.title: Ukrzaliznytsia not expecting freight traffic to increase in 2027
items.teaser: JSC Ukrzaliznytsia does not expect freight transportation to increase next year due to the blockade of seaports.

items.title: Russen verletzen in Region Donezk vier Zivilisten
items.teaser: Infolge des Beschusses der russischen Angreifer wurden vier Menschen am 14. November in der Region Donezk verletzt.

items.title: Islamisten als Wolf im Schafspelz? Bremen stoppt Kampagne
items.teaser: Der Bremer Verfassungsschutz will vor Islamisten warnen, die ohne Gewalt agieren. Die Art und Weise kommt nicht überall gut an.

items.title: Invaders hit company in Chuhuiv with drone, fire breaks out
items.teaser: A fire broke out at a company in Chuhuiv, Kharkiv region, after it was hit by a Russian drone.

items.title: Warehouses catch fire in Vyshhorod district following enemy attack
items.teaser: A fire broke out at a company’s warehouse facilities in the Vyshhorod district of the Kyiv region following a Russian attack on Sunday morning.

items.title: Ukraine strikes two petrochemical plants in Tatarstan and Russian helicopter manufacturing facility
items.teaser: Ukraine's General Staff says Ukrainian forces struck Nizhnekamskneftekhim, the Nizhnekamsk refinery's only primary distillation unit and the Monolit helicopter parts plant in Bryansk Oblast.

items.title: Selenskyj: Putin lehnt Waffenstillstand persönlich ab
items.teaser: Wladimir Putin persönlich unterstützt einen Waffenstillstand nicht.

items.title: Two injured in Russian drone strike on Bilozerka
items.teaser: Russian invaders attacked the village of Bilozerka in the Kherson region with a drone on Sunday morning, injuring two people.

items.title: Enemy drone attacks damage property in five districts of Kyiv region, one person injured
items.teaser: Damage from Russian drone attacks over the past 24 hours has been reported in five districts of the Kyiv region.
